description: Adds more tools: mocks (mock network requests or Electron APIs); cookies (read, set and delete cookies); device (emulate a phone or tablet, fake the location); extensions (install and open a browser extension); attach (launch Chrome with remote debugging, attach to a running WebDriver or Appium session); elements (raw element list with bounds); cloud-apps (upload and list mobile apps on BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, TestMu, TestingBot, Digital.ai).
name: enable_tools
